summary: High reel skip rate (77% in first 3s) shows hooks fail; Bluesky zero engagement. Instagram bio violates rules: niche (hotels/cafes/gyms/homestays), region (Himachal), timeframe (24 hrs), free site check offer outside website posts.
guidance:
- Rotate hook styles: try top3, contrast, question; avoid curiosity (0.07x).
- Stop repeating chatbot FAQ angles (multiple posts on same 5 questions, 2am leaks, after-9pm drops).
- Keep posts reading like a developer sharing real work, never an ad.
- Use broad national hashtags only (#FreelanceIndia #LeadGeneration #GetClients #SmallBusinessIndia).

instructions.research: Find 3 diverse Indian small-business types (e.g. salon in Jaipur, coaching centre in Kochi, gym in Indore) that lack websites but have Google Places listings with reviews.
instructions.analysis: Compare the lead-gen sheet columns (name, phone, website yes/no, review count, newly opened flag) against the research list to confirm coverage.
instructions.writer: Draft a lead-gen post opening with 'Freelancers, agencies, anyone selling a service' describing the sheet in general terms, using a top3 hook: '3 places to spot local businesses that need your service'.
instructions.image: Create a simple carousel slide showing a blurred Google Maps screenshot with overlay text: 'Business name • Phone • Website? • Reviews • New?' — no real data, just illustration.
instructions.video: Skip video today; focus on a static carousel for higher retention.

manual_tips: Update Instagram bio to remove niche, region, timeframe, and free site check; replace with national, service-agnostic description and 'pay after approval' offer.
Comment thoughtfully on 5 posts by Indian freelancers/agencies discussing client acquisition, using your personal account.
Reply to any existing DM or comment on your own posts within 2 hours to boost algorithm signals.
